decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt range is a publicly announced flagship central to the firm's organic and biodynamic direction, so the visible commitment and investment make withdrawal very unlikely.
The mild sliced cheese is a recent launch close to the core cheesemaking business and has its own product page, so any weak early results can still be put down to temporary ramp-up causes.

The sliced butter cheese uses existing in-house cheese capabilities and is presented publicly, so after only one year management would likely persist rather than write it off, though it is less central than the flagship.
